"""Audit the current, sequential C++/Rust comparison and derive per-run ratios."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import statistics

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PREFIX = ROOT / "docs/benchmarks/2026-10-16-current-cpp"

def main():
    output = {"passed": False, "matrices": {}, "totals": {},
              "scope": "Fresh, sequential, ordinary release trials; no overlapping builds, profiling or other load tests. Native Rust CBOR, no bridge. Each implementation/case has three six-second repetitions with alternating implementation order and rotated case order. Two active private pairs, 8192 idle single-member rooms, cyclic 1024-byte application values (1027 encoded bytes), 16-message windows. Complete sender/value/FIFO, queries, Close/EOF verified. This does not establish a language-only comparison, saturated multicore capacity, long-run or TLS behavior.",
              "collector": {"sha256": sha(Path(__file__)), "source": Path(__file__).read_text()},
              "runner_sources": {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): {"sha256": sha(p), "source": p.read_text()}
                                 for p in (ROOT / "scripts" / name for name in
                                           ("compare-cpp.py", "benchmark.py", "inspection.py", "reference.py"))}}
    totals = {name: 0 for name in ("trials", "healthy_deliveries", "reconnect_cycles", "queries", "normal_closes")}
    rust_manifest = ROOT / "docs/benchmarks/2026-10-16-handshake-inline-build.json"
    selected = json.loads(rust_manifest.read_text())
    output["selected_rust"] = {"runtime_implementation_revision": selected["runtime_implementation_revision"],
                               "manifest": str(rust_manifest.relative_to(ROOT)), "manifest_sha256": sha(rust_manifest),
                               "binary_sha256": selected["candidate"]["binaries"]["war-relay"]}
    for matrix in ("four-worker", "one-core"):
        path = Path(str(PREFIX) + "-" + matrix + ".json")
        data = json.loads(path.read_text())
        assert data["passed"] and len(data["cases"]) == 12
        assert data["rust_sha256"] == output["selected_rust"]["binary_sha256"]
        assert data["client_sha256"] == "5af8d672f365d0770a3a2a7c554fcfead2715c428bdc3c61137c514526037744"
        assert data["runner_sha256"] == sha(ROOT / "scripts/compare-cpp.py")
        summary = {"path": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)), "sha256": sha(path), "cases": {}}
        for row in data["cases"]:
            trace = ROOT / row["trace"]
            assert sha(trace) == row["trace_sha256"]
            detail = json.loads(trace.read_text())
            assert row["passed"] and detail["passed"] and detail["client_exit_code"] == 0
            assert not detail["server_forced_kill"]
            assert detail["server_exit_code"] == (0 if row["kind"] == "rust" else -15)
            assert detail["client_sources_sha256"] == data["client_sources_sha256"]
            assert detail["client_sha256"] == data["client_sha256"]
            assert detail["server_sha256"] == data[row["kind"] + "_sha256"]
            assert [e["event"] for e in detail["events"]] == ["ready", "measured", "done"]
            if row["kind"] == "rust":
                for event in detail["events"]:
                    assert event["metrics"]["war_routing_copied_bytes_total"] == 0
                final = detail["events"][-1]["metrics"]
                for name in ("war_connections", "war_sessions", "war_queued_bytes", "war_variable_bytes", "war_read_buffer_reserved_bytes"):
                    assert final[name] == 0, (trace, name, final[name])
            else:
                assert detail["listening_sockets"] == (4 if matrix == "four-worker" else 1)
                assert detail["startup_server"]["Threads"] == (6 if matrix == "four-worker" else 3)
            totals["trials"] += 1
            for name, activity in (("healthy_deliveries", "healthy"), ("reconnect_cycles", "churn"), ("queries", "inspection")):
                totals[name] += row["mixed"][activity]["verified"]
            totals["normal_closes"] += row["normal_closes"]
        for case in data["args"]["cases"]:
            result = {}
            for kind in ("cpp", "rust"):
                rows = [r for r in data["cases"] if r["case"] == case and r["kind"] == kind]
                assert len(rows) == 3
                result[kind] = dict(data["medians"][case + "/" + kind])
                result[kind]["server_cpu_ns_per_healthy_delivery_median_of_ratios"] = statistics.median(
                    r["mixed"]["server_cpu_seconds"] / r["mixed"]["healthy"]["verified"] * 1e9 for r in rows)
                if case == "query":
                    assert all(r["mixed"]["inspection"]["verified"] == 1200 for r in rows)
            cpp, rust = result["cpp"], result["rust"]
            result["rust_relative_to_cpp_percent"] = {
                "healthy_throughput": (rust["healthy"]["per_second"] / cpp["healthy"]["per_second"] - 1) * 100,
                "measured_rss": (rust["rss_measured_mib"] / cpp["rss_measured_mib"] - 1) * 100,
                "server_cpu_per_healthy_delivery": (rust["server_cpu_ns_per_healthy_delivery_median_of_ratios"] /
                    cpp["server_cpu_ns_per_healthy_delivery_median_of_ratios"] - 1) * 100}
            if case == "churn":
                result["rust_relative_to_cpp_percent"]["reconnect_throughput"] = (
                    rust["churn"]["per_second"] / cpp["churn"]["per_second"] - 1) * 100
            summary["cases"][case] = result
        output["matrices"][matrix] = summary
    assert totals["trials"] == 24
    output["totals"] = totals
    output["passed"] = True
    path = Path(str(PREFIX) + "-summary.json")
    path.write_text(json.dumps(output, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({"passed": True, "totals": totals, "summary": str(path.relative_to(ROOT))}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare original C++ binary and native Rust CBOR using common application work.

Build --release --bins --example inspection first. Each fresh process and client
run in their own private network namespace. No legacy bridge is on the hot path.
Timing runs must not overlap builds, profiles or other load tests.
"""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import select
import signal
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time

import benchmark as runtime
import inspection
import reference

ROOT = runtime.ROOT
CACHE = reference.CACHE


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def client_sources(args):
    adjacent = args.client.resolve().parent
    root = args.client_source_root
    if root is None:
        root = adjacent if (adjacent / "examples/inspection.rs").is_file() else ROOT
    root = root.resolve()
    return {"client_source_root": str(root),
            "client_source_attribution": "Source snapshot only; binary/source association requires the caller's build record.",
            "client_source_sha256": sha(root / "examples/inspection.rs"),
            "client_sources_sha256": {str(p.relative_to(root)): sha(p) for p in
                                      [root / "examples/inspection.rs"] + sorted((root / "examples/inspection").glob("*.rs"))}}


def rebuild_cpp(workers):
    """Apply only explicit worker configuration to a temporary upstream copy."""
    assert 1 <= workers <= 32
    build = CACHE / f"build-{workers}"
    build.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    original = (ROOT / "relay.cpp").read_bytes()
    before = b"std::vector<std::thread *> threads(std::thread::hardware_concurrency());"
    after = f"std::vector<std::thread *> threads({workers});".encode()
    assert original.count(before) == 1, "upstream worker configuration changed"
    source, binary = build / "relay.cpp", build / "app"
    source.write_bytes(original.replace(before, after))
    files = sorted((ROOT / "uws").glob("*.cpp"))
    command = ["clang++", "-O3", "-march=native", "-mrdrnd", "-fomit-frame-pointer", "-std=c++1z",
               "-o", str(binary), str(source), *map(str, files), f"-I{ROOT / 'uws'}",
               "-ltbb", "-lz", "-pthread", "-lssl", "-luv", "-lcrypto"]
    record = {"scope": "Upstream source with only worker-count configuration in a temporary copy. Routing/storage/protocol/uWS code unchanged; upstream build.sh flags, current system libraries.",
              "worker_configuration": {"before": before.decode(), "after": after.decode(), "workers": workers},
              "command": command, "compiler": subprocess.check_output(["clang++", "--version"], text=True),
              "library_versions": subprocess.check_output(["pkg-config", "--modversion", "openssl", "tbb", "libuv", "zlib"], text=True).splitlines(),
              "upstream_sources": {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): sha(p) for p in
                                   [ROOT / "relay.cpp", ROOT / "build.sh", *sorted((ROOT / "uws").glob("*"))] if p.is_file()},
              "configured_source_sha256": sha(source)}
    with tempfile.TemporaryFile() as log:
        completed = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, stdout=log, stderr=log)
        log.seek(0)
        record.update(exit_code=completed.returncode, build_log=log.read().decode(errors="replace"))
    assert completed.returncode == 0, record["build_log"]
    record["sha256"] = sha(binary)
    (build / "build.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
    return binary, record


def trial(args):
    namespace = os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/net")
    assert namespace != args.host_netns, "refusing reference listeners in host network namespace"
    cpp = args.kind == "cpp"
    rust_binary = args.control if args.kind == "control" else args.relay
    port, admin = (1338, 19139) if cpp else (19138, 19139)
    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items()
           if not k.startswith("WAR_") and k not in ("LD_PRELOAD", "LD_LIBRARY_PATH")}
    if cpp:
        server_command = [str(args.cpp_executable)]
        env.update(OPENSSL_CONF="/dev/null")
        if not args.cpp_system_libraries:
            env.update(LD_LIBRARY_PATH=str(CACHE / "root/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu"))
    else:
        server_command = [str(rust_binary), "--bind", f"127.0.0.1:{port}", "--admin-bind", f"127.0.0.1:{admin}",
                          "--workers", str(args.workers), "--messages-per-second", "0", "--bytes-per-second", "0",
                          "--ping-interval-secs", "0", "--idle-timeout-secs", "0"]
        env.update(WAR_AUTH_PASSWORD=inspection.TOKEN, WAR_ADMIN_TOKEN=inspection.TOKEN)
    churn = args.churn_workers if args.case == "churn" else 0
    mode = ("binary" if cpp else "cbor") if args.case == "query" else "none"
    client_command = [str(args.client), "--url", f"ws://127.0.0.1:{port}", "--wire", "cpp" if cpp else "cbor",
                      "--protocol-only", "--mode", mode, "--rooms", str(args.rooms), "--seconds", str(args.seconds),
                      "--pairs", str(args.pairs), "--churn-workers", str(churn), "--inspectors", str(args.inspectors),
                      "--inspection-interval-ms", str(args.inspection_interval_ms)]
    if args.server_cpus:
        server_command = ["taskset", "-c", args.server_cpus] + server_command
    if args.client_cpus:
        client_command = ["taskset", "-c", args.client_cpus] + client_command
    if args.audit_ids:
        client_command.append("--audit-ids")
    record = {"kind": args.kind, "case": args.case, "server_command": server_command,
              "client_command": client_command, "server_sha256": sha(args.cpp_executable if cpp else rust_binary),
              "client_sha256": sha(args.client), "runner_sha256": sha(__file__),
              **client_sources(args),
              "isolation": {"host_netns": args.host_netns, "test_netns": namespace,
                            "root_mount": "read-only", "writable_path": str(CACHE)},
              "events": [], "passed": False}
    started = time.monotonic()
    with tempfile.TemporaryFile(dir=CACHE) as logs, tempfile.TemporaryFile(dir=CACHE) as client_errors:
        server = subprocess.Popen(server_command, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=logs, stderr=logs)
        client = None
        try:
            if cpp:
                reference.wait_port(server, port)
            else:
                while True:
                    assert server.poll() is None, "Rust stopped during readiness"
                    try:
                        inspection.metrics(admin)
                        break
                    except OSError:
                        assert time.monotonic() - started < 5, "Rust management not ready"
                        time.sleep(.025)
            if cpp:
                # The unchanged program staggers one loop per hardware thread by
                # 100ms, then creates its collector. Wait for the collector too.
                deadline = started + (args.cpp_loop_count or os.cpu_count()) * .1 + .5
                while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                    assert server.poll() is None, "reference stopped during thread setup"
                    time.sleep(.025)
                # libstdc++ may report affinity-aware hardware concurrency; do
                # not assume Python's host CPU count equals the resulting loops.
                record["startup_server"] = runtime.snapshot(server.pid)
                listeners = [line for file in ("tcp", "tcp6") for line in Path(f"/proc/net/{file}").read_text().splitlines()[1:]
                             if line.split()[1].endswith(f":{port:04X}") and line.split()[3] == "0A"]
                record["listening_sockets"] = len(listeners)
                if args.cpp_loop_count:
                    assert record["startup_server"]["Threads"] == args.cpp_loop_count + 2, "C++ loop count differs"
                    assert len(listeners) == args.cpp_loop_count, "C++ listeners failed to bind"
                paths = {line.split()[-1] for line in Path(f"/proc/{server.pid}/maps").read_text().splitlines()}
                record["loaded_libraries"] = {p: sha(p) for p in sorted(paths) if p.startswith("/") and ".so" in p}
            client = subprocess.Popen(client_command, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                                      stderr=client_errors, text=True, env=env)
            ready = None
            while True:
                # The C++ lifetime contract below intentionally measures before
                # its first 30s collection. Retained member counts must be exact.
                assert time.monotonic() - started < (25 if cpp else args.seconds + 45), "case exceeded lifetime bound"
                assert server.poll() is None, "server stopped during workload"
                if not select.select([client.stdout], [], [], .1)[0]:
                    continue
                line = client.stdout.readline()
                assert line, "client exited before final gate"
                event = json.loads(line)
                event.update(server=runtime.snapshot(server.pid), client=runtime.snapshot(client.pid),
                             process_seconds=time.monotonic() - started)
                if not cpp:
                    event["metrics"] = inspection.metrics(admin)
                    if event["event"] == "ready":
                        stable_sessions = event["details"]["stable_sessions"]
                        stable_channels = event["details"]["stable_channels"]
                    inspection.check(event, stable_sessions, stable_channels,
                                     read_storage="connection" if args.kind == "control" else "worker", workers=args.workers)
                record["events"].append(event)
                if event["event"] == "ready":
                    ready = event
                elif event["event"] == "measured":
                    assert ready is not None
                    mixed = dict(event["details"])
                    for side in ("server", "client"):
                        mixed[f"{side}_cpu_seconds"] = event[side]["cpu_seconds"] - ready[side]["cpu_seconds"]
                        mixed[f"{side}_cpu_per_wall_second"] = mixed[f"{side}_cpu_seconds"] / mixed["elapsed_seconds"]
                    assert mixed["healthy"]["verified"] > 0
                    assert (mixed["churn"]["verified"] > 0) == (churn > 0)
                    assert (mixed["inspection"]["verified"] > 0) == (args.case == "query")
                    if args.case == "query":
                        wanted = args.seconds * 1000 // args.inspection_interval_ms * args.inspectors
                        assert mixed["inspection"]["verified"] == wanted, "inspection pacing fell behind"
                    record["mixed"] = mixed
                elif event["event"] == "done":
                    details = event["details"]
                    assert details["passed"] and details["counts"]["joins"] == details["counts"]["normal_closes"]
                    assert details["retired_churn_members_verified"] == (record["mixed"]["churn"]["verified"] if cpp else 0)
                else:
                    raise RuntimeError("unknown phase")
                client.stdin.write("continue\n")
                client.stdin.flush()
                if event["event"] == "done":
                    assert client.wait(timeout=5) == 0
                    record["passed"] = True
                    break
        except Exception as error:
            record["error"] = repr(error)
        finally:
            if client is not None:
                if client.poll() is None:
                    client.kill()
                    client.wait()
                record["client_exit_code"] = client.returncode
                client.stdin.close()
                client.stdout.close()
            server.terminate()
            record["server_forced_kill"] = False
            try:
                record["server_exit_code"] = server.wait(timeout=12)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                record["server_forced_kill"] = True
                server.kill()
                record["server_exit_code"] = server.wait()
            # C++ has no signal handler. Its expected stop is SIGTERM, whereas
            # Rust must complete its graceful shutdown and return zero.
            if record["server_forced_kill"] or record["server_exit_code"] != (-signal.SIGTERM if cpp else 0):
                record["passed"] = False
                record.setdefault("error", "unexpected server termination")
            logs.seek(0)
            client_errors.seek(0)
            record.update(server_log=logs.read().decode(errors="replace"),
                          client_log=client_errors.read().decode(errors="replace"))
            args.output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
    return record


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--relay", type=Path, default=ROOT / "target/release/war-relay")
    parser.add_argument("--client", type=Path, default=ROOT / "target/release/examples/inspection")
    parser.add_argument("--client-source-root", type=Path,
                        help="source snapshot root for a frozen client; defaults to adjacent examples when available")
    parser.add_argument("--control", type=Path, help="optional frozen async Rust control, measured with the identical client and gates")
    parser.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=4)
    parser.add_argument("--rooms", type=int, default=8192)
    parser.add_argument("--seconds", type=int, default=8, choices=range(1, 13))
    parser.add_argument("--pairs", type=int, default=2)
    parser.add_argument("--churn-workers", type=int, default=8)
    parser.add_argument("--inspectors", type=int, default=2)
    parser.add_argument("--inspection-interval-ms", type=int, default=10)
    parser.add_argument("--server-cpus", default="0-3")
    parser.add_argument("--client-cpus", default="4-7")
    parser.add_argument("--repetitions", type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument("--rebuild-cpp", action="store_true", help="build temporary upstream copy with explicit matching worker count and system libraries")
    parser.add_argument("--audit-ids", action="store_true", help="diagnostic only: check welcome ID reuse before C++ GC")
    parser.add_argument("--cases", nargs="+", choices=["private", "churn", "query"], default=["private", "churn", "query"])
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--isolated", action="store_true", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    parser.add_argument("--host-netns", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    parser.add_argument("--kind", choices=["cpp", "rust", "control"], help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    parser.add_argument("--case", choices=["private", "churn", "query"], help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    parser.add_argument("--cpp-executable", type=Path, default=CACHE / "app", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    parser.add_argument("--cpp-system-libraries", action="store_true", help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    parser.add_argument("--cpp-loop-count", type=int, default=0, help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.relay, args.client, args.output = (p.resolve() for p in (args.relay, args.client, args.output))
    args.cpp_executable = args.cpp_executable.resolve()
    if args.client_source_root: args.client_source_root = args.client_source_root.resolve()
    if args.control: args.control = args.control.resolve()
    if args.isolated:
        result = trial(args)
        print(json.dumps({"kind": args.kind, "case": args.case, "passed": result["passed"], "error": result.get("error")}), flush=True)
        return 0 if result["passed"] else 1
    assert args.repetitions > 0 and len(set(args.cases)) == len(args.cases)
    if args.rebuild_cpp:
        args.cpp_executable, cpp_build = rebuild_cpp(args.workers)
        args.cpp_system_libraries, args.cpp_loop_count = True, args.workers
        packages = []
    else:
        packages = reference.prepare()
        cpp_build = {"scope": "Pinned original shipped ELF; unknown build flags, isolated old libraries. Active listeners/threads are observed, not assumed from source.", "sha256": reference.APP_SHA}
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    record = {"timestamp_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), "host": platform.platform(),
              "cpu": subprocess.check_output(["lscpu", "-J"], text=True), "upstream_commit": reference.UPSTREAM,
              "packages": packages, "args": {k: str(v) if isinstance(v, Path) else v for k, v in vars(args).items()},
              "base_revision": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip(),
              "runner_sha256": sha(__file__), **client_sources(args),
              "client_sha256": sha(args.client), "rust_sha256": sha(args.relay), "cpp_sha256": sha(args.cpp_executable), "cpp_build": cpp_build,
              "scope": "Common application work, native Rust CBOR versus C++ binary protocol; no bridge. Same frozen client, 64 cyclic 1027-byte CBOR byte-string values (1024 application bytes), 16-message windows, two private pairs and idle rooms. C++ treats values as opaque; Rust validates CBOR. Each case runs fresh in a private net namespace, sequentially, pinned to the same server CPU set with client cores separate. Worker/library/build configuration is recorded in cpp_build; active listeners/threads checked for rebuilt C++. Case private: only private traffic. Case churn: private traffic plus fixed-room reconnect workers; every welcome, self delivery, Close/EOF checked, and C++ retired member counts verified before its first 30s GC. Case query: private traffic plus authenticated channel inspectors at fixed intervals, no churn; names/counts and full replies verified, sorting normalized only for C++ which does not promise it. HTTP management has no C++ counterpart. Setup and cleanup gated outside timing, every normal close counted, Rust counters/bytes/reservations checked. Latencies include client validation and concurrent client tasks, logarithmic percentile bucket upper bounds. RSS sampled at gates, not continuous peak/allocated memory. Server/client CPU covers all mixed work. Plaintext loopback, no TLS, rates/heartbeats off, default Rust queues; not a language-only or production-capacity comparison.",
              "cases": [], "passed": False}
    kinds = ["cpp", "rust"] + (["control"] if args.control else [])
    if args.control: record["control_sha256"] = sha(args.control)
    for repetition in range(1, args.repetitions + 1):
        offset = (repetition - 1) % len(args.cases)
        for case in args.cases[offset:] + args.cases[:offset]:
            first = (repetition - 1) % len(kinds)
            for kind in kinds[first:] + kinds[:first]:
                path = CACHE / f"bench-{case}-{kind}-{repetition}.json"
                path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                command = ["bwrap", "--unshare-net", "--unshare-pid", "--die-with-parent", "--ro-bind", "/", "/",
                           "--bind", str(CACHE), str(CACHE), "--proc", "/proc", "--dev", "/dev", "--",
                           sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), "--isolated", "--host-netns",
                           os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/net"), "--kind", kind, "--case", case,
                           "--relay", str(args.relay), "--client", str(args.client), "--workers", str(args.workers),
                           "--rooms", str(args.rooms), "--seconds", str(args.seconds), "--pairs", str(args.pairs),
                           "--churn-workers", str(args.churn_workers), "--inspectors", str(args.inspectors),
                           "--inspection-interval-ms", str(args.inspection_interval_ms),
                           "--cpp-executable", str(args.cpp_executable), "--cpp-loop-count", str(args.cpp_loop_count),
                           "--server-cpus", args.server_cpus, "--client-cpus", args.client_cpus, "--output", str(path)]
                if args.cpp_system_libraries:
                    command.append("--cpp-system-libraries")
                if args.audit_ids:
                    command.append("--audit-ids")
                if args.client_source_root:
                    command += ["--client-source-root", str(args.client_source_root)]
                if args.control:
                    command += ["--control", str(args.control)]
                completed = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT)
                detail = json.loads(path.read_text())
                trace = args.output.with_name(f"{args.output.stem}-{case}-{kind}-{repetition}.json")
                trace.write_text(json.dumps(detail, indent=2) + "\n")
                row = {"kind": kind, "case": case, "repetition": repetition, "trace": str(trace.relative_to(ROOT)),
                       "trace_sha256": sha(trace), "passed": detail["passed"]}
                if "mixed" in detail:
                    row.update(mixed=detail["mixed"], sampled_server_rss_kib=[e["server"]["VmRSS"] for e in detail["events"]],
                               server_threads=detail["events"][0]["server"]["Threads"],
                               normal_closes=detail["events"][-1]["details"]["counts"]["normal_closes"])
                record["cases"].append(row)
                args.output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
                assert completed.returncode == 0 and detail["passed"], detail.get("error")
                assert detail["client_sha256"] == record["client_sha256"]
                assert detail["server_sha256"] == record[f"{kind}_sha256"]
                assert detail["client_source_sha256"] == record["client_source_sha256"]
                assert detail["client_sources_sha256"] == record["client_sources_sha256"]
                assert detail["runner_sha256"] == record["runner_sha256"]
                print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
    record["medians"] = {}
    for case in args.cases:
        for kind in kinds:
            rows = [r for r in record["cases"] if r["kind"] == kind and r["case"] == case]
            middle = {activity: {k: statistics.median(r["mixed"][activity][k] for r in rows)
                                for k in ("per_second", "p50_upper_ms", "p99_upper_ms", "max_ms")}
                      for activity in ("healthy", "churn", "inspection")}
            for activity in ("healthy", "churn", "inspection"):
                middle[activity]["throughput_range"] = [min(r["mixed"][activity]["per_second"] for r in rows),
                                                        max(r["mixed"][activity]["per_second"] for r in rows)]
            for side in ("server", "client"):
                middle[f"{side}_cpu_per_wall_second"] = statistics.median(r["mixed"][f"{side}_cpu_per_wall_second"] for r in rows)
            middle["rss_ready_mib"] = statistics.median(r["sampled_server_rss_kib"][0] / 1024 for r in rows)
            middle["rss_measured_mib"] = statistics.median(r["sampled_server_rss_kib"][1] / 1024 for r in rows)
            record["medians"][f"{case}/{kind}"] = middle
    record["passed"] = True
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps({"passed": True, "medians": record["medians"]}), flush=True)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare read-buffer sizes with identical real-socket workloads in fresh servers.

Run from any directory after cargo build --release --bins --example load.
Results contain server-only RSS/CPU plus load-generator validation and latency.
Candidates run sequentially; order reverses on alternate repetitions.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import socket
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.request

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SERVER = ROOT / "target/release/war-relay"
LOAD = ROOT / "target/release/examples/load"


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


def snapshot(pid):
    values = {}
    for line in Path(f"/proc/{pid}/status").read_text().splitlines():
        if line.startswith(("VmRSS:", "VmSize:", "RssAnon:", "Threads:")):
            key, value = line.split(":", 1)
            values[key] = int(value.split()[0])
    fields = Path(f"/proc/{pid}/stat").read_text().split()
    values["cpu_seconds"] = (int(fields[13]) + int(fields[14])) / os.sysconf("SC_CLK_TCK")
    # Quiescent-gate diagnostics expose flow/worker placement without sampling
    # inside a timed request. Threads may retire between directory and stat.
    threads = {}
    for task in Path(f"/proc/{pid}/task").iterdir():
        try:
            fields = (task / "stat").read_text().rsplit(")", 1)[1].split()
            threads[task.name] = (int(fields[11]) + int(fields[12])) / os.sysconf("SC_CLK_TCK")
        except FileNotFoundError:
            continue
    values["thread_cpu_seconds"] = threads
    return values


def metrics(port):
    with urllib.request.urlopen(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/metrics", timeout=1) as response:
        return dict(line.split() for line in response.read().decode().splitlines() if line.startswith("war_"))


def trial(buffer, workload, clients, nagle=False):
    port, admin = free_port(), free_port()
    env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if not key.startswith("WAR_")}
    with tempfile.TemporaryFile() as logs:
        server = subprocess.Popen([
            str(SERVER), "--bind", f"127.0.0.1:{port}", "--admin-bind", f"127.0.0.1:{admin}",
            "--workers", "4", "--messages-per-second", "0", "--bytes-per-second", "0",
            "--ping-interval-secs", "0", "--read-buffer-bytes", str(buffer),
        ], stdout=logs, stderr=logs, env=env)
        try:
            for _ in range(200):
                if server.poll() is not None:
                    logs.seek(0)
                    raise RuntimeError(logs.read().decode())
                try:
                    metrics(admin)
                    break
                except OSError:
                    time.sleep(0.02)
            else:
                raise RuntimeError("server readiness timeout")
            baseline = snapshot(server.pid)
            command = [str(LOAD), "--url", f"ws://127.0.0.1:{port}"]
            if nagle:
                command.append("--nagle")
            if workload == "idle":
                process = subprocess.Popen(command + ["--mode", "idle", "--clients", str(clients), "--hold-secs", "2"], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
                try:
                    line = process.stdout.readline()
                    if not line:
                        raise RuntimeError(process.stderr.read())
                    result = json.loads(line)
                    observed = metrics(admin)
                    assert int(observed["war_sessions"]) == clients, observed
                    measured = snapshot(server.pid)
                    process.communicate(timeout=10)
                    assert process.returncode == 0
                finally:
                    if process.poll() is None:
                        process.kill()
                        process.communicate()
            else:
                args = {
                    "private-256": ["--mode", "private", "--clients", "128", "--messages", "1000", "--payload-bytes", "256"],
                    "private-65536": ["--mode", "private", "--clients", "32", "--messages", "200", "--payload-bytes", "65536"],
                    "broadcast-256": ["--mode", "broadcast", "--clients", "64", "--messages", "500", "--payload-bytes", "256"],
                }[workload]
                completed = subprocess.run(command + args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
                result = json.loads(completed.stdout)
                measured = snapshot(server.pid)
                observed = metrics(admin)
            return {"read_buffer_bytes": buffer, "workload": workload, "baseline": baseline, "measured": measured,
                    "server_cpu_seconds": measured["cpu_seconds"] - baseline["cpu_seconds"],
                    "server_rss_delta_kib": measured["VmRSS"] - baseline["VmRSS"], "metrics": observed, "result": result}
        finally:
            server.terminate()
            try:
                server.wait(timeout=12)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                server.kill()
                server.wait()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--repetitions", type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument("--idle-clients", type=int, default=2000)
    parser.add_argument("--buffers", type=int, nargs="+", default=[131072, 4096])
    parser.add_argument("--nagle", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--workloads", nargs="+", choices=["idle", "private-256", "private-65536", "broadcast-256"], default=["idle", "private-256", "private-65536", "broadcast-256"])
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    samples = []
    for repetition in range(args.repetitions):
        order = args.buffers if repetition % 2 == 0 else list(reversed(args.buffers))
        for workload in args.workloads:
            for buffer in order:
                sample = trial(buffer, workload, args.idle_clients, args.nagle)
                samples.append(sample)
                print(json.dumps({"repetition": repetition, "workload": workload, "buffer": buffer, "rss_kib": sample["measured"]["VmRSS"], "deliveries_per_second": sample["result"].get("deliveries_per_second")}), flush=True)
    output = {"host": platform.platform(), "cpu": subprocess.check_output(["lscpu"], text=True),
              "rustc": subprocess.check_output(["rustc", "--version"], text=True).strip(),
              "server_sha256": hashlib.sha256(SERVER.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "server_workers": 4,
              "load_sha256": hashlib.sha256(LOAD.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
              "client_tcp_nodelay": not args.nagle,
              "notes": "Loopback, no TLS, rates/heartbeat disabled only for benchmark. Fresh process per sample. RSS KiB excludes load generator and kernel socket memory. CPU time includes setup and teardown, elapsed/latency excludes setup. No affinity pinning.",
              "samples": samples}
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.output.write_text(json.dumps(output, indent=2) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Measure concurrent inspection, verified private traffic and connection churn.

Build --release --bins --example inspection first. Phases are gated to separate
population setup/teardown from the mixed workload. Profiles are diagnostic only.
"""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import select
import signal
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.request

import benchmark as runtime

ROOT = runtime.ROOT
TOKEN = "inspection-benchmark"  # Disposable fresh loopback process only.
ERRORS = ["war_handshake_errors_total", "war_origin_rejected_total", "war_join_rejected_total",
          "war_rejected_total", "war_protocol_errors_total", "war_rate_limited_total",
          "war_write_timeouts_total", "war_write_errors_total", "war_close_failures_total",
          "war_aborted_writes_total", "war_transport_disconnects_total", "war_slow_consumers_total",
          "war_global_pressure_total", "war_read_buffer_reservations_rejected_total", "war_idle_timeouts_total"]


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def dump_heap(pid, prefix):
    """Capture a quiescent gate with gperftools' documented dump signal."""
    # Current gperftools includes the PID in its prefix; older builds do not.
    before = set(prefix.parent.glob(prefix.name + "*.heap"))
    os.kill(pid, signal.SIGUSR2)
    deadline, previous = time.monotonic() + 5, None
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        created = set(prefix.parent.glob(prefix.name + "*.heap")) - before
        if len(created) == 1:
            path = created.pop()
            data = path.read_bytes()
            if data == previous and b"MAPPED_LIBRARIES:" in data and data.endswith(b"\n"):
                return {"path": str(path), "sha256": digest(path),
                        "header": data.splitlines()[0].decode()}
            previous = data
        time.sleep(.025)
    raise TimeoutError("heap dump did not complete at phase gate")


def metrics(port):
    request = urllib.request.Request(f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/metrics",
                                     headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {TOKEN}"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=3) as response:
        return dict((key, int(value)) for key, value in
                    (line.split() for line in response.read().decode().splitlines() if line.startswith("war_")))


def check(event, stable_sessions, stable_channels, read_storage="worker", workers=4, variable_bytes=6):
    observed, counts = event["metrics"], event["details"]["counts"]
    # Older frozen binaries predate the admission error counters.
    assert observed.get("war_accept_errors_total", 0) == 0
    assert observed.get("war_setup_errors_total", 0) == 0
    expected = {"war_accepted_total": counts["joins"], "war_joined_total": counts["joins"],
                "war_disconnected_total": counts["normal_closes"],
                "war_incoming_messages_total": counts["sent_messages"],
                "war_incoming_bytes_total": counts["sent_bytes"],
                "war_deliveries_total": counts["deliveries"],
                "war_delivered_bytes_total": counts["delivered_bytes"],
                "war_routing_reused_bytes_total": counts["value_bytes"],
                "war_routing_copied_bytes_total": 0, "war_queued_bytes": 0}
    done = event["event"] == "done"
    expected.update(war_connections=0 if done else stable_sessions,
                    war_sessions=0 if done else stable_sessions,
                    war_channels=1 if done else stable_channels,
                    war_variable_bytes=0 if done else variable_bytes)
    reserved = observed["war_read_buffer_reserved_bytes"]
    if read_storage == "connection":
        expected["war_read_buffer_reserved_bytes"] = 0 if done else stable_sessions * 8192
    else:
        # At these quiescent gates all application input is complete. Empty
        # decoders own no receive allocation; each worker may keep one 4KiB
        # scratch slab and its 2x growth allowance. An empty worker releases it.
        bound = 0 if done else workers * 8192
        assert 0 <= reserved <= bound, (event["event"], "worker receive allowance", reserved, bound)
        expected["war_read_buffer_reserved_bytes"] = reserved
        event["worker_read_allowance_bound"] = bound
    expected.update({key: 0 for key in ERRORS})
    for key, value in expected.items():
        assert observed[key] == value, (event["event"], key, observed[key], value)
    event["exact_counter_checks"] = expected


def run(args):
    port, admin = runtime.free_port(), runtime.free_port()
    while admin == port:
        admin = runtime.free_port()
    environment = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if not key.startswith("WAR_")}
    environment.update(WAR_AUTH_PASSWORD=TOKEN, WAR_ADMIN_TOKEN=TOKEN)
    server_environment = environment.copy()
    if args.heap_profile:
        args.heap_profile = args.heap_profile.resolve()
        args.heap_profile.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        assert args.heap_library.is_file(), "gperftools library is missing"
        assert not list(args.heap_profile.parent.glob(args.heap_profile.name + "*.heap")), "use a fresh heap-profile prefix"
        server_environment.update(LD_PRELOAD=str(args.heap_library.resolve()),
                                  HEAPPROFILE=str(args.heap_profile), HEAPPROFILESIGNAL=str(signal.SIGUSR2),
                                  HEAP_PROFILE_ALLOCATION_INTERVAL=str(100 * 1024**3),
                                  HEAP_PROFILE_INUSE_INTERVAL=str(100 * 1024**3))
    server_command = [str(args.server.resolve()), "--bind", f"127.0.0.1:{port}", "--admin-bind", f"127.0.0.1:{admin}",
                      "--workers", str(args.workers), "--messages-per-second", "0", "--bytes-per-second", "0", "--ping-interval-secs", "0"]
    command = [str(args.client.resolve()), "--url", f"ws://127.0.0.1:{port}", "--admin", f"127.0.0.1:{admin}",
               "--mode", args.mode, "--rooms", str(args.rooms), "--seconds", str(args.seconds),
               "--inspectors", str(args.inspectors), "--inspection-interval-ms", str(args.inspection_interval_ms),
               "--pairs", str(args.pairs), "--churn-workers", str(args.churn_workers)]
    if getattr(args, "page_size", None) is not None:
        command += ["--page-size", str(args.page_size)]
    if args.fanout_readers:
        command += ["--fanout-readers", str(args.fanout_readers)]
    if getattr(args, "fanout_churn_every", 0):
        command += ["--fanout-churn-every", str(args.fanout_churn_every)]
    if getattr(args, "fanout_window", 16) != 16:
        command += ["--fanout-window", str(args.fanout_window)]
    if args.server_cpus:
        server_command = ["taskset", "-c", args.server_cpus] + server_command
    if args.client_cpus:
        command = ["taskset", "-c", args.client_cpus] + command
    adjacent_sources = args.client.resolve().parent
    source_root = getattr(args, "client_source_root", None)
    if source_root is None:
        source_root = adjacent_sources if (adjacent_sources / "examples/inspection.rs").is_file() else ROOT
    result = {"timestamp_utc": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
              "host": platform.platform(), "server_command": server_command, "command": command,
              "server_sha256": digest(args.server), "client_sha256": digest(args.client),
              "client_source_root": str(source_root.resolve()),
              "client_source_attribution": "Source snapshot only; binary/source association requires the caller's build record.",
              "client_source_sha256": digest(source_root / "examples/inspection.rs"), "runner_sha256": digest(__file__),
              "client_sources_sha256": {str(p.relative_to(source_root)): digest(p) for p in
                                       [source_root / "examples/inspection.rs"] + sorted((source_root / "examples/inspection").glob("*.rs"))},
              "args": {key: str(value) if isinstance(value, Path) else value for key, value in vars(args).items()},
              "profile_diagnostic": args.profile or bool(args.heap_profile), "events": [], "passed": False,
              "scope": "Gated setup/mixed workload/cleanup. Stable single-member rooms include binary and Unicode names, private pairs have distinct rooms, health0 keeps a variable. Inspectors use authenticated HTTP or CBOR on a fixed per-worker interval, skipping missed ticks; every name, member count, field, ordering and complete response is verified. During churn, known churn rooms may appear with one member; quiescent snapshots before and after must contain exactly the stable rooms. Healthy traffic uses 64 cyclic 1KiB templates and 16-message windows; full sender/value/FIFO checked. Churn verifies welcome, exact 8-byte-counter self delivery, normal Close and EOF. All stable peers stay connected until the mixed workload ends; every close and final resource/counter/byte total is checked. Latencies include client-side verification and competing client tasks on separate CPU cores. Native CPU covers all mixed work, not an isolated cost per delivery. Loopback, no TLS, rates/heartbeat disabled, default queues. Event-boundary RSS is not continuous peak or allocated bytes. Profiles excluded from timing medians."}
    if args.heap_profile:
        result["heap_profiler"] = {"library": str(args.heap_library.resolve()),
                                   "library_sha256": digest(args.heap_library),
                                   "environment": {key: value for key, value in server_environment.items()
                                                   if key == "LD_PRELOAD" or key.startswith("HEAP")},
                                   "scope": "Server allocator replaced by gperftools. Requested live allocations only; profile timing and RSS are diagnostic and excluded from ordinary comparisons."}
    args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryFile() as logs, tempfile.TemporaryFile() as client_errors:
        server = subprocess.Popen(server_command, stdout=logs, stderr=logs, env=server_environment)
        client = perf = None
        perf_log = None
        try:
            started = time.monotonic()
            while True:
                if server.poll() is not None:
                    raise RuntimeError("relay stopped during readiness")
                try:
                    metrics(admin)
                    break
                except OSError:
                    if time.monotonic() - started > 5:
                        raise
                    time.sleep(.02)
            client = subprocess.Popen(command, stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                                      stderr=client_errors, text=True, env=environment)
            ready = None
            stable_sessions = stable_channels = None
            while True:
                if time.monotonic() - started > args.seconds + 75:
                    raise TimeoutError("inspection workload exceeded outer deadline")
                if not select.select([client.stdout], [], [], .25)[0]:
                    continue
                line = client.stdout.readline()
                if not line:
                    raise RuntimeError("inspection client stopped before final gate")
                event = json.loads(line)
                event.update(metrics=metrics(admin), process=runtime.snapshot(server.pid),
                             client_process=runtime.snapshot(client.pid), seconds=time.monotonic() - started)
                result["events"].append(event)
                if event["event"] == "ready":
                    stable_sessions, stable_channels = event["details"]["stable_sessions"], event["details"]["stable_channels"]
                    check(event, stable_sessions, stable_channels, args.read_storage, args.workers, 6 if args.pairs else 0)
                    if args.profile:
                        profile = args.output.with_suffix(".perf.data")
                        perf_log = tempfile.TemporaryFile()
                        perf = subprocess.Popen(["perf", "record", "-e", "cycles:u", "-F", "499", "--call-graph", "dwarf,8192",
                                                 "-p", str(server.pid), "-o", str(profile)], stdout=perf_log, stderr=perf_log)
                        time.sleep(.2)
                        if perf.poll() is not None:
                            raise RuntimeError("perf could not attach")
                        result["profile_path"] = str(profile)
                    ready = event
                elif event["event"] == "measured":
                    check(event, stable_sessions, stable_channels, args.read_storage, args.workers, 6 if args.pairs else 0)
                    if perf is not None:
                        perf.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)
                        result["perf_exit_code"] = perf.wait(timeout=10)
                        perf_log.seek(0)
                        result["perf_log"] = perf_log.read().decode(errors="replace")
                        perf_log.close()
                        perf = perf_log = None
                        assert result["perf_exit_code"] in (0, -signal.SIGINT), "perf failed"
                    mixed = dict(event["details"])
                    mixed["server_cpu_seconds"] = event["process"]["cpu_seconds"] - ready["process"]["cpu_seconds"]
                    mixed["server_cpu_seconds_per_wall_second"] = mixed["server_cpu_seconds"] / mixed["elapsed_seconds"]
                    mixed["client_cpu_seconds"] = event["client_process"]["cpu_seconds"] - ready["client_process"]["cpu_seconds"]
                    mixed["client_cpu_seconds_per_wall_second"] = mixed["client_cpu_seconds"] / mixed["elapsed_seconds"]
                    assert (mixed["healthy"]["verified"] > 0) == (args.pairs > 0)
                    assert (mixed["churn"]["verified"] > 0) == (args.churn_workers > 0)
                    assert (mixed["inspection"]["verified"] > 0) == (args.mode != "none" and args.inspectors > 0)
                    assert (mixed.get("fanout", {}).get("verified", 0) > 0) == (args.fanout_readers > 0)
                    assert (mixed.get("fanout_membership", {}).get("verified", 0) > 0) == (getattr(args, "fanout_churn_every", 0) > 0)
                    result["mixed"] = mixed
                    print(json.dumps(mixed), flush=True)
                elif event["event"] == "done":
                    check(event, stable_sessions, stable_channels, args.read_storage, args.workers, 6 if args.pairs else 0)
                    assert event["details"]["passed"]
                    assert event["details"]["counts"]["joins"] == event["details"]["counts"]["normal_closes"]
                else:
                    raise RuntimeError("unknown phase gate")
                if args.heap_profile:
                    event["heap"] = dump_heap(server.pid, args.heap_profile)
                client.stdin.write("continue\n")
                client.stdin.flush()
                if event["event"] == "done":
                    assert client.wait(timeout=5) == 0
                    result["passed"] = True
                    break
        except Exception as error:
            result["error"] = repr(error)
        finally:
            if perf is not None:
                perf.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)
                perf.wait(timeout=10)
            if perf_log is not None:
                perf_log.seek(0)
                result["perf_log"] = perf_log.read().decode(errors="replace")
                perf_log.close()
            if client is not None:
                if client.poll() is None:
                    client.kill()
                    client.wait()
                result["client_exit_code"] = client.returncode
                client.stdin.close()
                client.stdout.close()
            server.terminate()
            result["server_forced_kill"] = False
            try:
                result["server_exit_code"] = server.wait(timeout=12)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                result["server_forced_kill"] = True
                server.kill()
                result["server_exit_code"] = server.wait()
            logs.seek(0)
            client_errors.seek(0)
            result.update(server_log=logs.read().decode(errors="replace"), client_log=client_errors.read().decode(errors="replace"))
            if result["server_exit_code"] != 0 or result["server_forced_kill"]:
                result["passed"] = False
                result.setdefault("error", "relay did not exit cleanly")
            args.output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--server", type=Path, default=runtime.SERVER)
    parser.add_argument("--client", type=Path, default=ROOT / "target/release/examples/inspection")
    parser.add_argument("--client-source-root", type=Path,
                        help="Source snapshot root; defaults to sources beside a frozen client, then checkout context")
    parser.add_argument("--mode", choices=["none", "cbor", "http"], default="http")
    parser.add_argument("--page-size", type=int, help="HTTP first-page size during traffic; complete traversal verified at quiescent gates")
    parser.add_argument("--rooms", type=int, default=8192)
    parser.add_argument("--seconds", type=int, default=8)
    parser.add_argument("--inspectors", type=int, default=2)
    parser.add_argument("--inspection-interval-ms", type=int, default=10)
    parser.add_argument("--pairs", type=int, default=2)
    parser.add_argument("--churn-workers", type=int, default=8)
    parser.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=4, help="Native server worker count")
    parser.add_argument("--fanout-readers", type=int, default=0,

    parser.add_argument("--fanout-churn-every", type=int, default=0,
                        help="Join/retire a verifying room member every N fanout windows; zero disables")
    parser.add_argument("--fanout-window", type=int, default=16,

    parser.add_argument("--read-storage", choices=["worker", "connection"], default="worker",

    parser.add_argument("--server-cpus", default="0-3")

    parser.add_argument("--heap-library", type=Path, default=Path("/usr/lib/libtcmalloc.so"))
